source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    For pcie acs status check,run below command: (with root privilege)
Send command: "lspci -vvv | grep -i (keyword)". Check PCIe vender ID & device ID.
Send command: "lspci -s XXXX:XXXX –vvv | grep – i acs ".Check PCIe ACS Status.
check pcie capability section for corresponding PCIe device,
"ACSCtl: SrcValid-" ACS disable
"ACSCtl: SrcValid+" ACS enabled

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: PCIe device information should show correctly in OS

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- PCIe ACS_Status: read PCIe ACS status on the DUT. sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo lspci -D -vvv 2>&1 | grep -B1 -Ei 'ACSCtl|SrcValid' 2>&1"; an ACS-enabled port shows SrcValid+ and disabled shows SrcValid-.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the ACSCtl lines per PCIe device (SrcValid+/-) so the user confirms which devices have ACS enabled/disabled in OS.

original_test_intent: Report correct PCIe device identity and Access Control Services capability/control state, including whether Source Validation is enabled or disabled for each scoped function.
original_method: Collect domain-aware verbose lspci output per approved BDF, preserve complete ACS capability and control blocks, decode each supported bit and compare SrcValid or the full owner policy without writing configuration space.
manual_activity: A user supplies target BDFs and acceptance policy; complete read-only capability collection, parsing and comparison are automated.
required_inputs: Domain:BDF target list and vendor/device identity
Expected SrcValid-only or full ACSCtl policy
Handling for absent/reserved/OEM ACS and virtual functions
safety_requirements: Use only read-only lspci; never setpci, rescan, bind/unbind or toggle ACS.
Associate every ACSCap/ACSCtl block with the exact BDF and capability instance.
Do not equate SrcValid with all ACS functions unless the approved policy explicitly does.
Stop on truncated/ambiguous output or topology/health change; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect full domain-aware topology and per-BDF verbose output, decode ACSCap/ACSCtl bits and compare with the supplied policy.
Report unsupported/absent capability separately and preserve raw evidence without verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve target devices and the narrow SrcValid or complete ACS policy.
Adjudicate platform exceptions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: lspci is correct, but global grep -B1 can attach ACSCtl to the wrong device and drops other ACS capability/control bits.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run `lspci -D -s <BDF> -vvv` read-only per target and parse the complete PCI Express ACSCap/ACSCtl block.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The ACS/OS scope and 10/10-minute values remain; target placeholders require project input.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture raw per-function PCIe capability data and produce a table of supported versus enabled ACS controls keyed to stable domain:BDF and device identity.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record kernel, pciutils, BIOS and device firmware versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable PCI Express ACS capability/control definitions and platform policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces lossy global grep with device-bound full control decoding.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents wrong-device association and reveals controls beyond Source Validation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BDFs can change after topology changes; absent ACS must be judged against device type and project requirements.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define target functions and whether SrcValid alone is sufficient, but must retain the complete raw ACS block and disclose unsupported controls.
expected_evidence: Raw complete per-BDF lspci capability output
Parsed ACSCap and ACSCtl bit table

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently identifies ACS state and OS device correctness; policy breadth is a project readiness input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Once approved inputs are supplied, the read-only software core is fully automatable; missing target/policy does not reduce capability.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects global-grep association and SrcValid overstatement.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its full per-BDF decoding and no-write controls while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates approved inputs and engineer verdict from execution capability.

review_improvement: Produces trustworthy per-device ACS evidence instead of a context-free list of plus/minus tokens.
independent_technical_reasoning: ACS state is encoded in a device-local extended capability with multiple independent controls; reliable evaluation therefore requires exact BDF association and complete capability context.
